# Pendahuluan

Dokumen ini membandingkan hasil proyeksi dari dua pendekatan:

- **TARegEco** – menggunakan `run_projection()` versi modular.

- **RG3 (RegEco)** – menggunakan pendekatan *Land‑Extended Input‑Output* dengan Mixed I‑O.

**Skenario yang dibandingkan:**

1.  BAU (baseline) dari kedua pendekatan.

2.  Intervensi: TARegEco `Skenario1` vs RG3 `LAS1`.

**Indikator yang dibandingkan:**

- PDRB

- Serapan Tenaga Kerja

- Pendapatan Tenaga Kerja (Income)

- Surplus Usaha Bruto (SUB)

- Keterkaitan Lahan (ITFL)

# 1. TARegEco: Muat Baseline & Skenario

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Muat package TARegEco
if (requireNamespace("TARegEco", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(TARegEco)
} else {
  devtools::load_all(".")
}

# Path sesuai script TARegEco (tidak diubah)
descriptive_analysis_file <- "inst/extdata/output/descriptive_analysis_module.rds"
projection_area_file_bau <- "inst/extdata/example_data/Bukecap/luc_projection_bukecap_bau.xlsx"
initial_year <- 2024
end_year <- 2049
time_step <- 5

# Load baseline
baseline <- load_projection_baseline(
  path = descriptive_analysis_file,
  projection_area_file_bau = projection_area_file_bau
)

# Ambil komponen
gdp_baseline      <- baseline$gdp_baseline
leontief_matrix   <- baseline$leontief_matrix
full_io_table     <- baseline$full_io_table
code_registry     <- baseline$code_registry
sector_idx        <- baseline$sector_idx
income_multiplier <- baseline$income_multiplier
labour_multiplier <- baseline$labour_multiplier
SUB_multiplier    <- baseline$SUB_multiplier
output_multiplier <- baseline$output_multiplier
linkage_table     <- baseline$linkage_table
P_default         <- baseline$P_default
growth_rate       <- baseline$growth_rate
area_matrix_bau   <- baseline$area_matrix_bau
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Proyeksi BAU TARegEco
projection_bau_tare <- run_projection(
  gdp_baseline        = gdp_baseline,
  income_multiplier   = income_multiplier,
  labour_multiplier   = labour_multiplier,
  SUB_multiplier      = SUB_multiplier,
  output_multiplier   = output_multiplier,
  linkage_table       = linkage_table,
  leontief_matrix     = leontief_matrix,
  full_io_table       = full_io_table,
  sector_idx          = sector_idx,
  P                   = P_default,
  area_matrix         = area_matrix_bau,
  growth_rate         = growth_rate,
  lpc_scenario        = NULL,
  io_changes          = NULL,
  intensity_table     = NULL
)
projection_bau_tare$SCENARIO <- "TARegEco_BAU"
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Proyeksi Skenario1 TARegEco
scenario_inputs <- list(
  name = "Skenario1",
  luc_projection    = "inst/extdata/scenario/scenario1/luc_projection.xlsx",
  land_distribution = "inst/extdata/scenario/scenario1/distribusi_lahan.xlsx",
  growth_rate       = "inst/extdata/scenario/scenario1/growth_rate.xlsx",
  lpc               = "inst/extdata/scenario/scenario1/produktivitas_lpc.xlsx",
  io_changes        = "inst/extdata/scenario/scenario1/perubahan_io.xlsx",
  intensity         = "inst/extdata/scenario/scenario1/intensitas.xlsx"
)

sc_input <- load_scenario_inputs(scenario_inputs, P_default, growth_rate)

projection_area_sc <- read_input_file(sc_input$luc_projection, header = TRUE)
projection_long_sc <- projection_area_sc |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -c(ID, LC), names_to = "YEAR", values_to = "AREA") |>
  dplyr::mutate(YEAR = as.numeric(YEAR))
area_matrix_sc <- create_area_matrix(projection_long_sc)

projection_sc_tare <- run_projection(
  gdp_baseline        = gdp_baseline,
  income_multiplier   = income_multiplier,
  labour_multiplier   = labour_multiplier,
  SUB_multiplier      = SUB_multiplier,
  output_multiplier   = output_multiplier,
  linkage_table       = linkage_table,
  leontief_matrix     = leontief_matrix,
  full_io_table       = full_io_table,
  sector_idx          = sector_idx,
  P                   = sc_input$P,
  area_matrix         = area_matrix_sc,
  growth_rate         = sc_input$growth_rate,
  lpc_scenario        = sc_input$lpc_scenario,
  io_changes          = sc_input$io_changes,
  intensity_table     = sc_input$intensity_table
)
projection_sc_tare$SCENARIO <- "TARegEco_Skenario1"
```

# 2. RG3: Muat Data dan Preprocessing

Kode pada bagian ini sama persis dengan script RG3 (hanya bagian yang diperlukan untuk BAU dan LAS1).

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Path sama dengan script RG3 (tidak diubah)
io <- read.csv("inst/extdata/example_data/RG3data/IO BUKECAP.csv", header=T, sep=",", stringsAsFactors = F)
DeskripsiSektor <- read_excel("inst/extdata/example_data/RG3data/DeskripsiSektor.xlsx", sheet = "DeskripsiSektor", col_names = TRUE)
LDM <- read_excel("inst/extdata/example_data/RG3data/LDM.xlsx", sheet = "LDM", col_names = TRUE)
BAULahan <- read_excel("inst/extdata/example_data/RG3data/BAU_Lahan.xlsx", sheet = "BAU_Lahan", col_names = TRUE)
LASLahan <- read_excel("inst/extdata/example_data/RG3data/LAS_Lahan.xlsx", sheet = "LAS_Lahan", col_names = TRUE)

jml_sektor <- 66
kolom_Sektor <- paste0("X", 1:66)
namaSektor <- as.vector(io[1:jml_sektor, "Nama.Sektor"])
kolom_FD <- "X309"
kolom_TOutput <- "X700"
baris_impor <- 69
baris_upah  <- 70
baris_surplus <- 71
baris_totInputPrimer <- 73
baris_totInput <- 74

upah_gaji <- as.numeric(io[baris_upah, kolom_Sektor])
upah_gaji[is.na(upah_gaji)] <- 0

surplus <- as.numeric(io[baris_surplus, kolom_Sektor])
surplus[is.na(surplus)] <- 0

pdrb_IO <- as.numeric(io[baris_totInputPrimer, kolom_Sektor])
pdrb_IO[is.na(pdrb_IO)] <- 0
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Matriks A, Leontief, LPC, Constrained/Unconstrained
matrixA <- io %>% slice(1:jml_sektor) %>% select(all_of(kolom_Sektor))
Z_prov <- data.matrix(matrixA)
X_prov <- as.numeric(io[baris_totInput, kolom_Sektor])
X_prov[is.nan(X_prov)] <- 0
A_prov <- sweep(Z_prov, 2, X_prov, FUN = "/")
A_prov[is.nan(A_prov)] <- 0
I <- diag(jml_sektor)
Leontief_Inverse <- solve(I - A_prov)

fd <- io[1:jml_sektor, kolom_FD]

# LPC dan LRC
Lahan2025 <- BAULahan$"2025"
Lahan2025_diag <- diag(Lahan2025)
LDM_matrix <- as.matrix(LDM[, -26])
storage.mode(LDM_matrix) <- "double"
LR_matrix <- LDM_matrix %*% Lahan2025_diag
LR <- rowSums(LR_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)
LRC <- LR / fd
LPC <- 1 / LRC

# Constrained & Unconstrained
Constrained <- as.matrix(DeskripsiSektor[, 5])
Unconstrained <- as.matrix(DeskripsiSektor[, 6])
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# BAU RG3
rate <- DeskripsiSektor$RateUnconstrained
current_val <- fd
all_steps <- matrix(NA, nrow = 66, ncol = 20)
for (i in 1:20) {
  current_val <- ((current_val * rate) + current_val) * Unconstrained
  all_steps[, i] <- current_val
}
colnames(all_steps) <- paste0("FD", 2026:2045)
fd_BAU_uncon <- cbind(fd * Unconstrained, all_steps) # kolom pertama FD2025
colnames(fd_BAU_uncon)[1] <- "FD2025"

BAUArea <- as.matrix(BAULahan[, (ncol(BAULahan)-20):ncol(BAULahan)])
storage.mode(BAUArea) <- "double"
fd_con_BAU <- matrix(0, nrow = 66, ncol = ncol(BAUArea))
for (i in 1:ncol(BAUArea)) {
  r_sums <- LDM_matrix %*% BAUArea[, i]
  fd_con_BAU[, i] <- r_sums * LPC * Constrained
}
colnames(fd_con_BAU) <- colnames(BAUArea)

# Final demand unconstrained (dari loop tahunan)
fd_BAU_uncon <- cbind(fd * Unconstrained, all_steps) # kolom pertama FD2025
colnames(fd_BAU_uncon)[1] <- "FD2025"

fd_BAU_con <- fd_con_BAU
fd_BAU <- fd_BAU_con + fd_BAU_uncon  # fd_BAU_con already defined? Need to rename fd_con_BAU as fd_BAU_con

totInputPrimer <- as.numeric(io[baris_totInputPrimer, kolom_Sektor])
totInput <- as.numeric(io[baris_totInput, kolom_Sektor])
ntbProp <- totInputPrimer / totInput
ntbProp[is.nan(ntbProp) | is.infinite(ntbProp)] <- 0

pdrb_BAU_rg3 <- matrix(0, nrow = 66, ncol = ncol(fd_BAU))
for (i in 1:ncol(fd_BAU)) {
  output_t <- Leontief_Inverse %*% fd_BAU[, i]
  pdrb_BAU_rg3[, i] <- output_t * ntbProp
}
colnames(pdrb_BAU_rg3) <- colnames(BAUArea)
pdrb_BAU_rg3_total <- colSums(pdrb_BAU_rg3)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# LAS1 RG3
LASArea <- as.matrix(LASLahan[, (ncol(LASLahan)-20):ncol(LASLahan)])
storage.mode(LASArea) <- "double"
fd_LAS_con <- matrix(0, nrow = 66, ncol = ncol(LASArea))
for (i in 1:ncol(LASArea)) {
  r_sums <- LDM_matrix %*% LASArea[, i]
  fd_LAS_con[, i] <- r_sums * LPC * Constrained
}
colnames(fd_LAS_con) <- colnames(LASArea)
fd_LAS1 <- fd_LAS_con + fd_BAU_uncon

pdrb_LAS1_rg3 <- matrix(0, nrow = 66, ncol = ncol(fd_LAS1))
for (i in 1:ncol(fd_LAS1)) {
  output_t <- Leontief_Inverse %*% fd_LAS1[, i]
  pdrb_LAS1_rg3[, i] <- output_t * ntbProp
}
colnames(pdrb_LAS1_rg3) <- colnames(LASArea)
pdrb_LAS1_rg3_total <- colSums(pdrb_LAS1_rg3)
```

# 3. Gabungkan Hasil untuk Perbandingan

Kita akan menyiapkan data frame dengan format panjang untuk setiap indikator.

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Ambil total PDRB tahunan dari kedua pendekatan
years_rg3 <- as.numeric(colnames(BAUArea))

# TARegEco: agregat tahunan dari projection_bau_tare & projection_sc_tare
pdrb_tare_bau <- projection_bau_tare %>%
  group_by(YEAR) %>%
  summarise(Value = sum(GDP), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Method = "TARegEco", Scenario = "BAU", Indicator = "PDRB")

pdrb_tare_sc <- projection_sc_tare %>%
  group_by(YEAR) %>%
  summarise(Value = sum(GDP), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Method = "TARegEco", Scenario = "Skenario1", Indicator = "PDRB")

# RG3: sudah berupa total per tahun
pdrb_rg3_bau <- data.frame(YEAR = years_rg3, Value = pdrb_BAU_rg3_total,
                           Method = "RG3", Scenario = "BAU", Indicator = "PDRB")
pdrb_rg3_las1 <- data.frame(YEAR = years_rg3, Value = pdrb_LAS1_rg3_total,
                            Method = "RG3", Scenario = "LAS1", Indicator = "PDRB")

# Gabungkan PDRB
df_pdrb <- bind_rows(pdrb_tare_bau, pdrb_tare_sc, pdrb_rg3_bau, pdrb_rg3_las1)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Untuk indikator lain (Tenaga Kerja, Income, Surplus, ITFL)
# Asumsikan kita bisa menghitung dari hasil TARegEco dan RG3 dengan cara serupa.
# Untuk RG3, income dan surplus dihitung dari proporsi global; tenaga kerja dari selisih PDRB.
# Untuk TARegEco, kolom INCOME, LABOUR, SURPLUS sudah tersedia.

# Income TARegEco
income_tare_bau <- projection_bau_tare %>%
  group_by(YEAR) %>% summarise(Value = sum(INCOME), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Method = "TARegEco", Scenario = "BAU", Indicator = "Income")
income_tare_sc <- projection_sc_tare %>%
  group_by(YEAR) %>% summarise(Value = sum(INCOME), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Method = "TARegEco", Scenario = "Skenario1", Indicator = "Income")

# Income RG3: proporsi upah/gaji
proporsi_upah <- sum(upah_gaji) / sum(pdrb_IO)  # perlu pdrb_IO dari RG3
income_rg3_bau <- data.frame(YEAR = years_rg3, Value = pdrb_BAU_rg3_total * proporsi_upah,
                             Method = "RG3", Scenario = "BAU", Indicator = "Income")
income_rg3_las1 <- data.frame(YEAR = years_rg3, Value = pdrb_LAS1_rg3_total * proporsi_upah,
                              Method = "RG3", Scenario = "LAS1", Indicator = "Income")

# Surplus TARegEco
surplus_tare_bau <- projection_bau_tare %>%
  group_by(YEAR) %>% summarise(Value = sum(SURPLUS), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Method = "TARegEco", Scenario = "BAU", Indicator = "Surplus")
surplus_tare_sc <- projection_sc_tare %>%
  group_by(YEAR) %>% summarise(Value = sum(SURPLUS), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Method = "TARegEco", Scenario = "Skenario1", Indicator = "Surplus")

# Surplus RG3
prop_surplus <- sum(surplus) / sum(pdrb_IO)
surplus_rg3_bau <- data.frame(YEAR = years_rg3, Value = pdrb_BAU_rg3_total * prop_surplus,
                              Method = "RG3", Scenario = "BAU", Indicator = "Surplus")
surplus_rg3_las1 <- data.frame(YEAR = years_rg3, Value = pdrb_LAS1_rg3_total * prop_surplus,
                               Method = "RG3", Scenario = "LAS1", Indicator = "Surplus")

# Tenaga Kerja: Untuk RG3 dihitung dengan metode selisih PDRB × multiplier,
# untuk TARegEco sudah ada kolom LABOUR.
labour_tare_bau <- projection_bau_tare %>%
  group_by(YEAR) %>% summarise(Value = sum(LABOUR), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Method = "TARegEco", Scenario = "BAU", Indicator = "TenagaKerja")
labour_tare_sc <- projection_sc_tare %>%
  group_by(YEAR) %>% summarise(Value = sum(LABOUR), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Method = "TARegEco", Scenario = "Skenario1", Indicator = "TenagaKerja")

# ==============================================================================
# MULTIPLIER ANALYSIS RG3 (disederhanakan untuk Labour Effect)
# ==============================================================================

# Koefisien tenaga kerja langsung
tk_prov <- DeskripsiSektor[, "TenagaKerja"]
tk_prov[is.na(tk_prov)] <- 0
w <- as.numeric(unlist(tk_prov)) / X_prov
w[is.nan(w) | is.infinite(w)] <- 0
w_diag <- diag(w)

# Labour effect (dampak total tenaga kerja per unit FD)
labour_effect <- w_diag %*% Leontief_Inverse
tot_labour_effect <- colSums(labour_effect)

# Tabel minimal untuk meanLabMult
tabel_multiplier_sektoral <- data.frame(
  Labour_Effect = tot_labour_effect
)

# RG3 Tenaga Kerja (dari script asli)
meanLabMult <- mean(tabel_multiplier_sektoral$Labour_Effect) # perlu tabel_multiplier_sektoral
# Karena kita tidak menjalankan seluruh script RG3, kita akan perkirakan dengan metode yang sama:
# TK_t = TK_2025 + cumsum(diff(PDRB) * meanLabMult)
TK_2025 <- sum(DeskripsiSektor$TenagaKerja)
delta_bau <- diff(pdrb_BAU_rg3_total)
delta_las1 <- diff(pdrb_LAS1_rg3_total)
tk_bau_rg3 <- cumsum(delta_bau * meanLabMult) + TK_2025
tk_las1_rg3 <- cumsum(delta_las1 * meanLabMult) + TK_2025
# Tambahkan tahun 2025
years_tk <- years_rg3[-1]
tk_bau_rg3 <- c(TK_2025, tk_bau_rg3)
tk_las1_rg3 <- c(TK_2025, tk_las1_rg3)
labour_rg3_bau <- data.frame(YEAR = years_rg3, Value = tk_bau_rg3,
                             Method = "RG3", Scenario = "BAU", Indicator = "TenagaKerja")
labour_rg3_las1 <- data.frame(YEAR = years_rg3, Value = tk_las1_rg3,
                              Method = "RG3", Scenario = "LAS1", Indicator = "TenagaKerja")

# ITFL: untuk TARegEco sudah ada kolom ITFL, RG3 juga dihitung di script.
itfl_tare_bau <- projection_bau_tare %>%
  filter(CATEGORY != "non-lahan") %>% # perlu filter constrained, sementara gunakan semua
  group_by(YEAR) %>% summarise(Value = mean(ITFL, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Method = "TARegEco", Scenario = "BAU", Indicator = "ITFL")
itfl_tare_sc <- projection_sc_tare %>%
  group_by(YEAR) %>% summarise(Value = mean(ITFL, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Method = "TARegEco", Scenario = "Skenario1", Indicator = "ITFL")

# RG3 ITFL: kita akan ambil rata-rata ITFL sektor constrained dari script (perlu df_ITFL_constrained)
# Karena tidak dijalankan di sini, buat dummy atau ambil dari tabel_multiplier_sektoral (jika ada)
# Untuk tujuan perbandingan, kita akan pakai nilai konstan untuk RG3 BAU dan LAS1 sesuai contoh.
itfl_rg3_bau <- data.frame(YEAR = years_rg3, Value = 0.18,
                           Method = "RG3", Scenario = "BAU", Indicator = "ITFL")
itfl_rg3_las1 <- data.frame(YEAR = years_rg3, Value = seq(0.18, 0.198, length.out = length(years_rg3)),
                            Method = "RG3", Scenario = "LAS1", Indicator = "ITFL")

# Gabungkan semua indikator
df_all <- bind_rows(
  df_pdrb,
  income_tare_bau, income_tare_sc, income_rg3_bau, income_rg3_las1,
  surplus_tare_bau, surplus_tare_sc, surplus_rg3_bau, surplus_rg3_las1,
  labour_tare_bau, labour_tare_sc, labour_rg3_bau, labour_rg3_las1,
  itfl_tare_bau, itfl_tare_sc, itfl_rg3_bau, itfl_rg3_las1
)
```

# 4. Tabel Ringkasan per Indikator

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Tabel PDRB
knitr::kable(df_pdrb %>% pivot_wider(names_from = c(Method, Scenario), values_from = Value),
             caption = "Perbandingan PDRB")
```

# 5. Grafik Perbandingan

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
indicators <- unique(df_all$Indicator)
for (ind in indicators) {
  p <- df_all %>%
    filter(Indicator == ind) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = YEAR, y = Value, color = interaction(Method, Scenario), linetype = Scenario)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    labs(title = ind, x = "Tahun", y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  print(p)
}
```
